title: O aplicativo fica atualizando sozinho mesmo com as opções desmarcadas
summary: The reporter says PowerToys keeps updating with automatic download disabled. The screenshots prove the options are off but show only an up-to-date result and last-check time, not an installed-version change.
next_action: Ask whether the installed version changes or only the last-check time changes, and request the initiating update screen only if an installation occurs.

judgment.rationale: A background update check is separate from an automatic installer download. The two screenshots do not show which operation the reporter calls an update. First distinguish routine version checks from an actual install, then identify its initiating surface; do not infer a setting-persistence bug or Store ownership from the installation-source field.
evidence: The Portuguese report identifies Microsoft Store installation, per-user stable 0.101.2362 and elevated execution.
Both screenshots were viewed: the automatic download/install checkbox and notification/release-note options are unchecked; Home shows 0.101.2362, up-to-date and a last-verification time.
The only comment requests English translation and the issue has Needs-Author-Feedback. No answer or installation evidence has arrived.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the installed version changes or only the last-check time changes, and request the initiating update screen only if an installation occurs.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report does not yet identify an applicable PowerToys code correction. No fix is proposed from an unlocalized symptom; this is not a conclusion that the behavior is expected or externally owned.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says PowerToys keeps updating with automatic download disabled. The screenshots prove the options are off but show only an up-to-date result and last-check time, not an installed-version change.
known_information: The report is understandable in Portuguese: PowerToys reportedly updates itself despite the automatic-download option being unchecked.
The screenshots establish the unchecked options and the displayed version 0.101.2362; they do not show an installer or a before/after version change.
The report supplies Windows build 26300, per-user installation, stable channel and elevated execution; these need not be requested again.
The Needs-Author-Feedback label follows an automated translation request, not a demonstrated update diagnosis. No assignee or linked fix is present.
inferences: The reporter may be interpreting the last-check timestamp as an automatic installation, but an actual unsolicited installation remains possible.
Microsoft Store installation alone does not establish that a Store background updater caused the behavior.
issue_context.analysis: A background update check is separate from an automatic installer download. The two screenshots do not show which operation the reporter calls an update. First distinguish routine version checks from an actual install, then identify its initiating surface; do not infer a setting-persistence bug or Store ownership from the installation-source field.
initial_investigation: PeriodicUpdateWorker continues obtaining version information while deriving download_update from downloadUpdatesAutomatically and the GPO setting: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a/src/runner/UpdateUtils.cpp#L246-L283

ProcessNewVersionInfo records the check result independently and only enters the installer-download branch when download_update is true: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a/src/runner/UpdateUtils.cpp#L155-L167 ; https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a/src/runner/UpdateUtils.cpp#L206-L213
Viewed both original issue image attachments rather than interpreting their filenames as bug reports.
No linked upstream/fork fix or matching fork branch was found. The translation request does not prevent a focused behavior clarification.

information_gaps.information: Whether the installed version changes without a manual install or only the last-verification time changes.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguish automatic installation from the update checks that remain enabled by design.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State which happens; if the version changes, provide the version shown before and after.

information_gaps.information: If an installation occurs, the PowerToys installer/update or Microsoft Store screen that identifies the initiating surface.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determine which updater path actually performs the install before assigning ownership.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Upload a screenshot of that update screen through the GitHub web UI with personal information hidden; no extra image is needed for a last-check-time-only change.

comment.body:
Obrigado pelas duas capturas: elas mostram a versão 0.101.2362 e as opções desmarcadas. A tela inicial também mostra o horário da última verificação; verificar uma versão nova é diferente de baixar/instalar uma atualização.

Please confirm (pode responder em português):
1. A versão instalada muda sem você iniciar a instalação, ou muda apenas o horário de “Última verificação”? Se a versão muda, informe a versão anterior e a posterior.
2. Somente se ocorre uma instalação, envie pela interface web do GitHub uma captura da tela de atualização/instalador do PowerToys ou da Microsoft Store que aparece nesse momento, ocultando informações pessoais.

Isso permite distinguir uma verificação normal de uma instalação automática e identificar qual atualizador está envolvido.
